evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/n/c/d/d directly as exact ScriptPacket ID 41.

Every meaningful selector branch in the handler is raid-interface state: selectors 0-7 dispatch only into rs/n/c/d raid UI classes/widgets, while selectors 15-22 control raid overlays, raid timers/points, raid affliction/interface state, or the raid difficulty requirement dropdown. Selectors 8-14 and 16 have no unrelated behavior.

The targeted rs/n/c/d subsystem independently preserves raid-specific strings/resources including 'Invocations', 'Party', 'Join party', 'Raid Type & Difficulty', 'Chambers of Xeric', 'Theatre of Blood', 'Raid Difficulty', 'Raid Selection', raid difficulty names, and raids/* assets.

The handler constructs and manages rs/l/f/a/g/a, whose exact surviving identity literal is 'RaidPartyOverlay' with 'Your points:' and 'Time:' state, plus sibling raid overlays including the surviving 'RaidTheatreBar' literal; selectors 18-20 update that live overlay's visibility, timer and points.

Selector 22 updates the raid difficulty dropdown at interface 32430 using the surviving requirement vocabulary 'Adept (Req. 10+ ...)', 'Expert (Req. 50+ ...)', 'Master (Req. 100+ ...)' and default suffix 'raids', while selector 21 toggles the same rs/n/c/d raid-interface state.

proposals.note: RaidInterfacePacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 41. Its complete meaningful selector surface is confined to the exact raid interface/overlay subsystem; no surviving original class identifier is claimed. Confidence is 0.998.
